program_name: Apple One (1) Year Limited Warranty (AirPods, AirTag and Apple accessories; U.S.)
coverage_summary: AirPods, AirTag, Apple Pencil, Magic Keyboard and other Apple-branded accessories bought in the U.S., for faults in the first year
watch_phrases: For product originally purchased in the U.S.A, Apple is Apple Inc.
is warranted against defects in materials and workmanship for a period of ONE (1) YEAR from the date of original retail purchase
coverage: Defects in materials and workmanship when used in accordance with Apple's user manuals, for one year from the date of original retail purchase
remedy: At Apple's option: repair at no charge with new or previously used Apple genuine parts, exchange for the same model (or with your consent a product with the same or substantially similar features), or a refund of the original purchase price
mandatory_conditions: The defect arises during the one-year Warranty Period
The product is an Apple-branded accessory used in line with Apple's user manuals
Contact Apple to claim; you can claim with Apple even if you bought the product from another store
Proof of purchase may be required to verify eligibility
exclusions_and_caveats: Not covered: normal depletion of consumable parts such as batteries, unless the failure is due to a defect in materials or workmanship
Not covered: damage from abuse, accident, modifications, unauthorized repairs or other causes that are not defects in materials and workmanship
Apple may restrict warranty service to the country where Apple or its Authorized Distributors originally sold the product
Apple does not promise a repair or replacement without risk to, or loss of, data stored on the product
Third-party cases, chargers and bands are not Apple products, so they are not covered by this warranty
This warranty is in addition to your consumer-law rights, not instead of them
claim_action: Contact Apple Support, or visit an Apple Store or Apple Authorized Service Provider, before {deadline}. To see your coverage, sign in at mysupport.apple.com. Have proof of purchase ready.
visible_damage_note: Visible physical damage was recorded in the evidence photo. Apple's accessory warranty does not cover damage from abuse, accident or other causes that are not defects; AppleCare coverage, if you have it, may.
